purpose: Acquisition authority and coverage evidence for Minnesota physical-grid classes. This ledger records source availability, not an inventory of physical assets and not statewide completeness.
truth_boundary: A source marked unavailable, restricted, denied, or candidate closes only that acquisition attempt. It neither changes the physical class to complete nor permits inferred assets, geometry, terminals, or connectivity.

sources.publisher: Minnesota Geospatial Information Office / Minnesota Public Utilities Commission
sources.authority: Official statewide electric utility service-area map; the PUC describes it as the official map under its April 9, 2014 Order in Docket 12-957.
sources.license_or_terms: No reusable license statement was returned by the service metadata; preserve publisher metadata and obtain terms before redistribution.
sources.spatial_extent: Minnesota statewide retail electric service areas
sources.geometry_accuracy_basis: Publisher describes PUC/utility review and ongoing boundary updates. The service metadata queried for this ledger does not provide a positional-accuracy value.

verified_query.count_meaning: Current FeatureServer feature count, not a count of utilities, grid assets, feeders, substations, or customers.

sources.publisher: Minnesota Geospatial Information Office / Minnesota Department of Commerce
sources.version_or_vintage: notice dated 2022-07-20 on the current MnGeo utilities page
sources.spatial_extent: Minnesota statewide historical transmission lines and substations
sources.geometry_accuracy_basis: MnGeo states that, because of existing accuracy problems and insufficient current information, Commerce cannot continue to support distribution and use of this dataset.
sources.unavailability_reason: Publisher withdrawal for accuracy and currency; it cannot be upgraded to a current source-backed asset layer by conflation with its historical records.

sources.license_or_terms: No reusable license statement was captured from queried layer metadata; retain service attribution and verify terms before redistribution.
sources.spatial_extent: Mille Lacs County map-service scope only; never Minnesota statewide
sources.geometry: native MapServer point and polyline features
sources.geometry_accuracy_basis: No numeric positional-accuracy statement was captured from the layer metadata. Geometry is source-provided, but its accuracy is source-undocumented in this ledger.

verified_layers.denominator_scope: Features returned by this source layer on 2026-09-06, not every physical substation in Mille Lacs County and not a statewide denominator.
Features returned by this source layer on 2026-09-06, not every physical line in Mille Lacs County and not a statewide denominator.

sources.access: public permitting index and eDockets links
sources.spatial_extent: individual applications, certificate-of-need and route-permit records
sources.geometry: may include applicant exhibits; neither a single statewide feature service nor a statewide denominator was verified
sources.geometry_accuracy_basis: Must be read from the particular filing/exhibit; none is assumed from the index.
sources.acquisition_condition: Record docket, document identifier, filing date, source checksum, page/layer and supersession status for every selected exhibit.

sources.access: MTEP map access requires a MISO website login; reliability-model FTP access requires appropriate CEII NDA/UNDA documentation according to the publisher.
sources.spatial_extent: MISO regional planning and model scope; not Minnesota-only
sources.geometry_accuracy_basis: unavailable until an authorized artifact and its metadata are acquired
does_not_support: publicly acquired Minnesota statewide network in this repository
sources.restriction_reason: No credentials, account request, NDA, or authorized source-owner request was used for this ledger.

sources.spatial_extent: selected solar, wind, battery-storage and large-transmission projects in permitting context
sources.geometry_accuracy_basis: The PUC says markers are approximate and the map does not include all pending or permitted transmission projects.

physical_class_coverage.reason: Official retail service-area geometry is available, but it is not a physical-network asset inventory.

physical_class_coverage.denominator_scope: No verified statewide physical-line denominator. The county service has 31 returned line features in its own scope.
physical_class_coverage.reason: Statewide source was withdrawn by its publisher for accuracy/currentness; county geometry cannot establish statewide coverage.
No current, authoritative statewide source with a verified subtransmission classification was acquired.

physical_class_coverage.denominator_scope: No verified statewide physical-substation denominator. The county service has 11 returned point features in its own scope.
physical_class_coverage.reason: County geometry is source-backed but does not supply statewide completeness or electrical terminals.
No statewide support/tower inventory with native geometry and accuracy basis was acquired.
EUSA polygons identify retail service territory only. No statewide feeder, device, terminal or distribution-connectivity source was acquired.
No source-backed terminal-to-terminal edge set was acquired. Geometry, proximity, roads, imagery and synthetic cases cannot create connectivity.
Interfaces to Manitoba, North Dakota, South Dakota, Iowa and Wisconsin require asset-specific source evidence. MISO planning/model acquisition is restricted and no authorized artifact was acquired.

implementation_handoff.safe_next_acquisition: For the 2WKG-448 corridor task, ingest only public, source-provided county or docket feature geometries after retaining source URL, feature/layer ID, retrieved_at, source CRS, transformed EPSG:4326 geometry, and source-documented accuracy basis. Preserve the source's local denominator and explicitly leave statewide denominator null.
forbidden_derivations: network edges from line endpoint proximity
substation assignment from imagery or street data
current statewide coverage from the retired Minnesota transmission/substation dataset
implementation_handoff.generation_boundary: EIA-860 facility/generator and storage inventory is owned by the dedicated generation track and is intentionally not duplicated in this ledger.
